properties.name: Asgard — Realm of the Gods (Mythical)
properties.description: Mythical realm of the Aesir gods, connected to Midgard (Earth) by Bifrost, the rainbow bridge. Contains Valhalla, Gladsheim, and other divine halls.

properties.name: Uppsala Temple (Gamla Uppsala)
properties.description: Ancient temple where Norse gods Thor, Odin, and Freyr were worshipped. Site of the greatest sacrificial festivals in Scandinavia.

properties.name: Yggdrasil — The World Tree (Mythical)
properties.description: The cosmic ash tree connecting the nine worlds of Norse mythology. Its roots reach Niflheim, Jotunheim, and Asgard.
properties.modernStatus: Mythical — represented in Viking Age art and runestones

properties.name: Þingvellir (Thingvellir)
properties.description: Where the Icelandic Althing (world's oldest parliament) met from 930 CE. A tectonic rift valley where the continents visibly separate.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, Icelandic national park
